What Ollie Says, Part 1: voice audition (Creator plan)

Each Polish take was transcribed back by speech-to-text: "✓ exact" means every word came back right. Voice Design refused child voices (ElevenLabs safety rules), so the children are library character voices.

1. The toddler voice: L1 and L5 (the hook's "That isn't his voice")

Should sound about three, calm and sleepy, and clearly younger than Ollie. A real three-year-old speaks at roughly 280–400 Hz.

Mini · L1 281 Hz · round trip: ✓ exact
Mini · L5 291 Hz · round trip: ✓ exact
Teddy Twinkle · L1 229 Hz · round trip: ✓ exact
Teddy Twinkle · L5 308 Hz · round trip: ✓ exact
Leo · L1 291 Hz · round trip: ✓ exact
Leo · L5 172 Hz · round trip: ✓ exact

2. Ollie, 6: his own voice (English)

Must sound OLDER than the toddler voice. Leo (242 Hz) is lower than every toddler candidate; Teddy and Valf are higher, so they'd sound younger than the toddler. None is British; Leo has a light Spanish accent.

Leo 242 Hz
Teddy Twinkle 320 Hz
